metadata.name: HydroBASINS catchments intersecting Pakistan operational areas
metadata.note: Full transboundary HydroBASINS level 5 sub-basins intersecting the portal's operational ADM1 areas (original v1c polygons, simplified for display without gaps or overlaps). These are sub-basins, not station-specific upstream watersheds.
metadata.attribution: Lehner, B., Grill, G. (2013): Global river hydrography and network routing. Hydrological Processes, 27(15): 2171-2186. https://doi.org/10.1002/hyp.9740
metadata.simplification: topology-preserving: each boundary shared by two sub-basins is simplified once and used by both, so neighbours share exact edges
